description: Read the code from an Amazon sticker: tells an LPN (License Plate Number) from an FNSKU, ASIN, FBA box label, Amazon Logistics tracking number or UPC/EAN, and explains each part. It cannot look up which product a code belongs to.

code.description: The code as printed on the sticker, e.g. LPN RR AB1234567

name: check_amazon_code
